query.comment: I) Without considering Frogger: the environment composed of VehicleLane, FloatingLane and DivingCycle never reaches a deadlock. Verify by activating the system WITHOUT Frogger/GameManager.
II) Without considering Frogger: vehicles and floating objects stay in their predefined row. Movement is modeled with per-row horizontal offsets, so only the horizontal position changes.
III) Frogger can reach the leftmost bay, cells (0,12)-(1,12).
IV) Frogger can reach the central bay (8,12)-(9,12) with exactly 17 points: 1 point per upward step + 5 for the free bay.
V) Frogger can reach a safe yellow cell in row 6 after the player has lost two lives.
VI) Frogger can stand on a log with five lives at least 10 seconds after the game starts. 10 s = 100 t.u., measured by globalClock.
VII) Frogger can die while riding a diving turtle when the cycle transitions to the submerged state.
